title: Dependency assessment context
description: The context file (<workDir>/context.json) an item's dependency assessment starts from. `depscore.py assess-context` (scripts/portfolio/assesscontext.py) writes it before the session starts: EpicContext for the dependency-assessment workflow (handed to the epic-dependency-assessor), TaskContext for the task-dependency-assessment workflow (handed to the task-dependency-mapper). It names files and matrix ids and copies no document. The $defs here are also the shared parts of the two edge proposals, epic-edge-proposal.schema.json and task-edge-proposal.schema.json.

Command.description: The depscore.py command that wrote the file.

Source.description: The tracker read the command worked from.

Warnings.description: What the tracker read warned of.

Confidence.description: How sure the assessing session is that the edge passes the test. `low` is drawn and argued about, never left out.

Withdrawal.description: One owned standing edge the proposal withdraws.

from.description: The standing edge's `from`, exactly as the context's `standing` gives it.

to.description: The standing edge's `to`, exactly as the context's `standing` gives it.

reason.description: Why the edge does not pass the test, answering the reason recorded for it.

StandingEdge.description: One edge already standing between the assessed item and another open bead of its level, in either direction (`edgeset.standing_edges`). `from` is the bead elaborated (Epic) or built (Task) first. An edge with `owned: false` was drawn by hand: the proposal leaves it out of both its lists. Every owned one is kept in `edges` or withdrawn in `withdrawn`.

type.description: The beads dependency type of the edge.

owned.description: True when an assessment set the edge; false when it was drawn by hand.

reason.description: The reason recorded when the edge was set; null when none is recorded.

confidence.description: The confidence recorded with it; null when none is recorded.

setBy.description: Who set it; null when not recorded.

setAt.description: When it was set; null when not recorded.

WithdrawalRecord.description: One edge touching the assessed item that an earlier assessment withdrew (`edgeset.withdrawal_history`). It was judged not to exist for `reason`: a proposal sets it again only with `answers` on the edge, saying why that reason is wrong.

reason.description: The recorded withdrawal reason; null when none is recorded.

withdrawnBy.description: Who withdrew it; null when not recorded.

withdrawnAt.description: When it was withdrawn; null when not recorded.

EpicContext.description: The context of one Epic's architecture-dependency assessment (`assesscontext.assess_context`).

elaborationState.description: The Epic's elaboration state, or null.

prdPath.description: The Epic's PRD file, absolute, as the matrix names it; null when the matrix names none.

related.description: Each other Epic the matrix relates to this one (`atw-matrix related --epic`), in the order the matrix returned them.

prdPath.description: Its PRD file, absolute; null when the matrix names none.

shared.description: Each entry both Epics reach and the relationship each reaches it through (`drives` and `restsOn` included), as `atw-matrix related --epic` prints its `shared` list. Each names the matrix entry; `atw-matrix epic <id>` names the related Epic's requirements and the PRD heading of each.

similar.description: Only for an Epic no feature serves yet: other Epics' requirements and features that share words with its requirements, as `atw-matrix find --kinds requirement,feature` prints its `matches`. A requirement's id names its Epic; a feature carries the Epics it serves.

summary.description: The counts of the lists above.

TaskContext.description: The context of one Task's build-dependency assessment (`assesscontext.task_context`), for a Task created outside elaboration.

task.description: The Task assessed. `beads-contract.py contract <id>` prints its title, description, build contract and stated ids.

epic.description: Its Epic's beads id, or null.

elements.description: The matrix ids its `matrix_elements` metadata key states: its stack, the entries it builds and the shared capabilities it uses. Empty when it states none.

stacks.description: The stacks those ids name, and the stacks that hold the entries they name, in id order.

unmatched.description: Stated ids that are the id of no matrix entry.

stacks.description: For each stack in `task.stacks`: what the matrix and the open Tasks say about it.

work.description: The open Tasks that name the stack or an entry it holds, as `atw-matrix work --id <stack id>` prints them.

dependsOn.description: What the stack depends on, as `atw-matrix deps --of <stack id>` prints it.

dependents.description: What depends on the stack, as `atw-matrix deps --on <stack id>` prints it.

summary.description: The counts of the lists above.
